files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- Recipes: optional measuring steps, ticked in the "Mixing and kneading" section: "Measure the dough temperature" (after kneading, otherwise after mixing) for the actual friction, and "Weigh the dough" (after the first shaping or balling) for the actual loss margin. In a bake, these steps show the matching field and a "Noted" button (web and Android).

### Changed
- Recipes: the duration of each fold and of each wait between folds can be changed one by one in the steps (the first fold can be longer than the last); the section's duration stays the default and changing it resets all of them (web and Android).

### Fixed
- A recipe created from a bake now takes the timed durations of each fold and wait (they were replaced by the section's duration).
- Share page on a phone: the ingredients table no longer overflows the card (headers wrap, tighter cells).
